, dragging a corner — moves every outlet on its faces with it and changes no byte of the outlets. An element keeps its distance from its wall's start junction, exactly as an opening does: one on a wall whose end moves along the wall stays where it is, and one on a wall whose start moves along the wall moves with the start. Changing a wall's thickness or justification moves its faces, and the elements on them, the same way.
